minor.issue: fetch_dividend intermittently returns None under concurrent load (Yahoo quoteSummary crumb race). Negative result is cached for 300s so dividend card & totals go to 0 for ~5min after transient failures. Consider reducing negative TTL to ~30s and adding a single retry with fresh crumb before caching None.

action_items: Consider reducing recommendations.py DIVIDEND_TTL negative-cache from 300s to ~30s and adding one retry on empty result to reduce dividend-blank windows.
critical_code_review_comments: recommendations.fetch_dividend: on exception the empty error is logged as 'dividend fetch failed X: ' (empty repr for httpx read errors). Cache-None TTL 300s is aggressive — a single transient failure blanks the Dividends card for 5 min for all users. Split cache: retry-quick (30s) on None, full TTL only on real success.
user_data.portfolio_dividends: for sym in shares dict + zip with divs order relies on Python dict insertion order preservation; correct on 3.7+ but pair with symbol list explicitly for robustness.

user_data.portfolio_dividends: 'upcoming' logic uses `ex_date >= now-86400 OR pay_date >= now` — pay_date in past + ex_date in future keeps upcoming=true, but for TD.TO both dates are future -> upcoming=true (OK). AAPL has ex/pay in Aug 2026 (past today Sep 21 2026) -> upcoming=false (matches UI). Good.
PriceAlertDialog: pct target validation at 150 correctly rejected server-side (400). Consider also client-side max hint to avoid a round-trip.
alerts.AlertInput.kind: Literal type rejects unknown kinds with 422 as expected. Good.
ShareButton: share-copy uses navigator.clipboard which fails silently on non-HTTPS or without permission; already handled with 'Could not copy link' toast.

success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (dashboard toggle+persistence, dividend card+rows+total, watchlist pct alert create+display+delete, article share popover on signed-in and signed-out, regression pages)
